disease: Alzheimer's disease, cross-sectional detection from peripheral blood
supersedes: v2.0 (2026-04-23) — v2.1 adds full-inline universal_reference block, lessons_learned section (5 documented quirks including VAL-057 consolidated with sex-stratified recovery, tauopathy-directional trend, cohort batch offset), and known_limitations updates for GSE53740 non-replication. Tier remains cross_platform_validated.

stage_1_immune_flag.rationale: Same universal Stage 1 substrate as breast and CRC cards. Buffy coat is approximately 70% immune cells. AD drives systemic immune drift that is measurable at the methylation level in peripheral blood. Brain tissue is not in the sample; AD is detected via its immune-compartment echo.

panel_pooled_null_documented.source: canonical 29-CpG IMM_CPGS_RAW panel intersected with AIBL EPIC platform coverage (62% transfer rate)
panel_pooled_null_documented.pooled_entropy_result: VAL-050 on AIBL GSE153712 (n=161 AD + 94 MCI + 471 HC): d = +0.077, p_MWU = 0.321, AUC = 0.512 — NULL
panel_pooled_null_documented.interpretation: Pooled-entropy A-score on a breast-cancer-derived panel does NOT transfer direction-blind to AD. The per-CpG Δβ pattern in AD is bidirectional — some CpGs go up, some go down — and pooling averages the signal to zero. This null result DRIVES the directional approach below.

panel_directional_primary.selection_rule: Rule A on AIBL training split (80% of cohort). Criterion: |Δβ| > 0.015 AND q_FDR < 0.10 on training only. Directions frozen before holdout access.
panel_directional_primary.platform_transfer: 7 of 7 CpGs present on both EPIC 850K and 450K — 100% transfer rate

stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method_primary: A_dir — directional composite: z-score each CpG's beta against training-HC mean and SD, multiply by frozen direction, sum. Report raw A_dir and age-regressed A_dir.
stage_1_immune_flag.scoring_method_secondary: A_pooled — pooled entropy A-score on same 7 CpGs. Reported alongside A_dir per VAL-051 Directional-Score Principle. Secondary metric.
stage_1_immune_flag.expected_direction: POSITIVE A_dir (AD cases elevated above HC after directional weighting)
stage_1_immune_flag.biological_interpretation: Alzheimer's drives bidirectional methylation drift in the immune compartment. Some immune-class CpGs increase beta, some decrease. Pooled entropy averages this to zero. Directional weighting captures the signed signal. Per VAL-040 cohort-level meta-analysis (n=3,424), 4 of 8 architecture classes are elevated in AD including peripheral immune. Per VAL-051 per-patient analysis, the Rule A directional composite recovers the signal at AUC 0.68 on AIBL holdout.

VAL_050_aibl_pooled_null.cohort: AIBL GSE153712, EPIC 850K, n=726 (161 AD + 94 MCI + 471 HC)
VAL_050_aibl_pooled_null.outcome: NULL — pre-registered negative. Motivates directional approach.
VAL_050_aibl_pooled_null.per_cpg_pattern: 18/18 CpGs show directional structure but mixed signs — 10 positive Δβ, 8 negative Δβ. Pooling cancels the signal.

VAL_051_aibl_directional_holdout.outcome: FULL RECOVERY — directional weighting recovers the signal pooled entropy missed

null_comparator_same_cohort.interpretation: Pooled entropy null d=+0.056 on the EXACT SAME samples same CpGs confirms it is the scoring method, not the cohort, driving the null.

VAL_052_cross_platform_replication.cohort: AddNeuroMed GSE144858, Illumina 450K, n=300 (93 AD + 111 MCI + 96 HC), multi-center European (UK/Finland/Italy/France/Poland/Greece)
VAL_052_cross_platform_replication.panel_transfer: 7/7 Rule A CpGs present on 450K (100% platform transfer)
VAL_052_cross_platform_replication.outcome_age_corrected: OUTCOME 3-borderline — most of the raw signal is age-tracked (R²=0.26); residual AD-specific signal after age regression is weaker
VAL_052_cross_platform_replication.EDEAR_clinical_decision: Report age-adjusted A_dir as the primary clinical metric per VAL-052 §4. Report raw A_dir as secondary metric alongside.

VAL_053_sex_specific_panels.question: Do sex-specific AD panels outperform the unified 7-CpG panel?
VAL_053_sex_specific_panels.result: No. Panel-F (10 CpGs female-trained) on female holdout d=+0.585 vs unified d=+0.705. Panel-M (1 CpG male-trained) under-selects.
VAL_053_sex_specific_panels.outcome: OUTCOME 4 — unified panel is the right EDEAR production choice. Sex-specific calibration is a future research direction, not a production requirement.

VAL_054_age_confound_bounds.VAL_054a: NON-TEST — 80-cell baseline interpolator saturates at oldest decade (panel β subset maps all samples to age 95). Honest non-test, not a passed validation.

VAL_054b_hc_internal_permutation.method: 10,000-permutation resample within HC only, size-matched to AD holdout
VAL_054b_hc_internal_permutation.verdict: STRONG — observed AD signal exceeds within-HC variance (including age variance) at p=0.003. Within-HC confounds alone cannot explain the AIBL-holdout result.

VAL_040_cohort_level_support.reference: VAL-040 Alzheimer's multi-class peripheral drift (7 tissue-class combinations)
VAL_040_cohort_level_support.cohorts: De Jager 2014, Shireby 2022, Nabais 2021 meta-analysis (n=3,424), Lunnon 2014
VAL_040_cohort_level_support.result: 4/4 predictions confirmed · 4 architecture classes elevated in AD (terminal, immune, secretory, stromal) · 7/7 severity gradient (late > early AD)
VAL_040_cohort_level_support.interpretation: At the cohort level, AD is multi-class systemic drift measurable peripherally. VAL-051 per-patient AIBL analysis refines this to the directional metric on the immune class specifically.

VAL_057_gse53740_consolidated.cohort: GSE53740 Ferrari 2014, GIFT cohort, UCSF-MAC, Illumina 450K, peripheral blood, n=384
VAL_057_gse53740_consolidated.composition: 193 HC + 15 AD + 128 FTD (FTD + FTD-MND) + 44 PSP/CBD (PSP + CBD) + 4 excluded
VAL_057_gse53740_consolidated.independence: Not used in VAL-051 (AIBL training) or VAL-052 (AddNeuroMed replication). External.
VAL_057_gse53740_consolidated.pre_registered_primary_outcome: O4 — NULL IN GSE53740 (pooled A_dir d=+0.013, p=0.96)

analysis_2_sex_stratified.interpretation: Male AD signal replicates AIBL male magnitude. Female AD does NOT replicate AIBL female. Pooled null from opposing sex contributions.

analysis_3_per_cpg_direction_preservatio.interpretation: Frozen AD Rule A panel direction pattern matches PSP/CBD (5/7) better than GSE53740 AD (4/7, near chance). Suggests panel detects tauopathy-associated drift at least as well as AD-specific drift.

analysis_4_80cell_age_anchor.interpretation: +2.306 SD cohort-level batch offset vs Cookbook baseline. Ferrari 2014 ComBat + quantile normalization systematic offset. 80-cell baseline not directly applicable to this cohort without cross-cohort normalization.

post_hoc_analyses_added_due_to_prereg_ga.analysis_5_A_dir_by_age_decade: No consistent age-interaction rescue of AD signal

VAL_057_gse53740_consolidated.verdict: Tier stays cross_platform_validated. Card adds mandatory sex stratification, tauopathy-specificity caveat, cross-cohort-normalization requirement.

DETECTABLE_AD_RISK.action: Recommend cognitive screening (MoCA, MMSE) and Stage 3 immune sub-composition

URGENT_AD_RISK.action: Recommend neurology referral, amyloid PET or CSF biomarkers if clinically indicated

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Strong signal. Neurology workup regardless of cognitive symptoms.

tier_thresholds_for_A_dir.tier_source: VAL-054b HC-internal permutation distribution provides the empirical tier boundaries. p99 = +2.85σ is the floor-breach threshold.

stage_2_localization.trigger: Stage 1 AD-directional flag at DETECTABLE_AD_RISK or stronger
stage_2_localization.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution — SAME universal Stage 2 as breast and CRC cards

ad_specific_expectation.primary_expectation: AD typically does NOT produce a dominant solid-organ tissue localization. Brain (neuron/oligodendrocyte) tissue does not shed cfDNA into peripheral buffy coat at levels Moss NNLS can resolve.
ad_specific_expectation.expected_Stage_2_pattern: All 18 tissue ΔA values near healthy baseline, no tissue exceeds DETECTABLE tier. Stage 2 returns 'no solid-organ localization — proceed to Stage 3'.
ad_specific_expectation.if_Stage_2_does_localize_to_a_tissue: Not the AD pattern. This suggests either (a) concurrent solid-organ disease, (b) AD-plus-cancer comorbidity (documented association in aging literature), or (c) the AD-directional flag was a false positive picking up a cancer signal. Clinician resolves.

stage_2_localization.validation_anchor: VAL-041 tested 10 solid-organ cancer types and achieved 10/10 top-1 correct localization. VAL-041 did NOT test AD — no Moss atlas tissue-of-origin signature is expected to dominate for a neurodegenerative disease that affects brain tissue not represented in buffy coat plasma.
stage_2_localization.interpretation_rule: For AD, the expected Stage 2 result is 'NULL LOCALIZATION' which is itself diagnostic-consistent with AD and not a failure.

stage_3_subcomposition.trigger: Stage 1 AD-directional flag at DETECTABLE_AD_RISK or stronger AND Stage 2 returned no solid-organ localization (expected AD pattern)
stage_3_subcomposition.method: EpiDISH RPC deconvolution of same IDAT into 6 immune sub-types: CD4+ T-cell, CD8+ T-cell, NK, B cell, monocyte, neutrophil (Salas 2018 reference)

ad_expected_pattern.systemic_shift: AD literature supports T-cell senescence pattern (CD4+/CD8+ ratio shift), elevated neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio, and altered monocyte methylation. Exact EpiDISH signature for AD is not yet defined as a validated threshold within EDEAR — this is a NEXT-TIER validation (VAL-056 or later).
ad_expected_pattern.current_card_claim: EDEAR Stage 3 for AD reports the 6-cell-type proportion vector with Salas 2018 healthy bounds check. Interpretation is descriptive until a validated AD-specific Stage 3 threshold is established.

stage_3_subcomposition.validation_tier_for_Stage_3_AD: exploratory — Stage 3 sub-composition is descriptive for AD pending a dedicated AD-specific sub-composition validation. Stage 1 directional panel remains the validated clinical signal.

mandatory_elements: A_dir age-regressed score (PRIMARY clinical metric per VAL-052 §4)
A_pooled score alongside (per Directional-Score Principle, always report both)
A_dir age-matched z-score against training-HC mean and SD
Tier call on the age-regressed A_dir
Stage 2 result if run (expected: no solid-organ localization for AD)
Stage 3 immune sub-composition if run (descriptive for AD)
Known limitations section including VAL-052 age-confound note
report_contents.language_discipline: Report must use 'AD-directional immune signature detected at [tier] level' — NEVER 'diagnoses AD', 'confirms AD', 'validates AD'. Report is a flag that changes downstream workup. Final AD diagnosis requires clinical assessment, cognitive testing, and neurological evaluation per standard of care.
report_contents.age_context_disclosure_mandatory: Report MUST disclose that a meaningful fraction of the A_dir signal tracks chronological age (R²=0.26 in VAL-052). Age-regressed A_dir is the primary clinical metric precisely because of this. Raw A_dir is reported for transparency.

validation_tier: cross_platform_validated — AIBL internal holdout (VAL-051 d=+0.62, p=0.001, AUC=0.68) + AddNeuroMed external cross-platform replication (VAL-052 raw d=+0.33, age-regressed d=+0.12). HC-internal permutation bound (VAL-054b) confirms signal exceeds within-HC variance at p=0.003. Sex-specific panels do not outperform unified (VAL-053). Unified 7-CpG Rule A panel is the EDEAR production choice.
known_limitations: Raw A_dir contains substantial age-tracked component (R²=0.26 in VAL-052). Age-regressed A_dir is approximately 38% of raw effect size (d=+0.12 vs +0.33 on AddNeuroMed). Clinical deployment MUST use age-adjusted output.
Per-patient sensitivity at 95% specificity is approximately 25-30% at d=0.62 (holdout). EDEAR AD deployment is cohort screening and serial trajectory monitoring, NOT single-timepoint AD diagnosis.
Only two cohorts tested at per-patient level: AIBL (Australian) and AddNeuroMed (multi-center European). ADNI and Framingham cohorts are dbGaP-gated and pending access.

VAL-054a attempted cellular-age regression via the 80-cell baseline and was a NON-TEST (baseline interpolator saturated). VAL-054b HC-internal permutation provided a valid bound but is not a direct age-confound resolution — it shows the signal exceeds within-HC variance, including age variance within HC. Direct age-regression came from VAL-052 on AddNeuroMed where age metadata was available.

Stage 2 Moss NNLS is not diagnostic-positive for AD (expected null localization). Stage 3 EpiDISH is descriptive pending a validated AD-specific sub-composition threshold. Stage 1 directional A_dir remains the sole validated clinical metric.

VAL-053 established unified panel as production choice. Sex-specific panels did not beat unified. However, female signal (d=+0.705) is stronger than male (d=+0.512) on the unified panel. This is a reported observation, not a configuration choice.
Holdout n=33 AD on AIBL is modest. 95% CI on Cohen's d is [+0.24, +1.06] — credible but not precise.

VAL-057 GSE53740 external pooled test did not replicate the AIBL/AddNeuroMed primary finding (pooled A_dir d=+0.013, p=0.96; O4 NULL per pre-registered decision matrix). Post-hoc sex stratification recovered male AD d=+0.415 (n=7) consistent with AIBL male d=+0.512; female AD d=-0.131 (n=7) did NOT replicate AIBL female d=+0.705. AIBL + AddNeuroMed two-cohort replication stands. Tier remains cross_platform_validated. GSE53740 non-replication is an honest external test result; the card explicitly discloses it rather than hiding it.

VAL-057 post-hoc per-CpG analysis found that the frozen AD Rule A panel preserved 5/7 direction signs on GSE53740 PSP/CBD samples vs only 4/7 on GSE53740 AD samples. The panel may detect tauopathy-associated immune drift as well as or better than AD-specific drift in populations outside AIBL/AddNeuroMed. The card cannot claim AD-vs-tauopathy differential diagnosis until a dedicated head-to-head cohort confirms.

VAL-057 post-hoc 80-cell age anchor found GSE53740 HC sit +2.306 SD above the Cookbook baseline — a systematic cohort-level batch offset from Ferrari 2014 preprocessing. Implication: the 80-cell Cookbook baseline cannot be applied directly to any non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort. Deployment requires either within-cohort HC re-anchoring or a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale.

Sex stratification is now a mandatory covariate. All ad-immune reports must include sex and may apply sex-specific scoring calibration. VAL-051 AIBL showed female d=+0.71 > male d=+0.51; VAL-057 GSE53740 showed male d=+0.41 > female d=-0.13. Sex effects on the panel are real and population-dependent.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned._purpose: Disease-specific quirks encountered during validation and deployment.

lessons.context: AIBL GSE153712, IMM_CPGS_EPIC_18 panel, pooled-entropy A-score
lessons.quirk: Pooled-entropy A-score produced d=+0.077 p=0.32 AUC=0.51 — NULL on the AD cohort despite VAL-040 meta-analysis showing cohort-level AD immune-class elevation. Per-CpG examination revealed 10 of 18 CpGs with positive Δβ and 8 with negative Δβ — bidirectional pattern.
lessons.interpretation: Pooled-entropy H(β) is symmetric around β=0.5; up-moves in one CpG and down-moves in another both change entropy similarly, and the pooled mean cancels. Bidirectional disease drift requires a directional scoring scheme.
lessons.applied_to_card: Primary scoring moved from pooled-entropy to A_dir directional composite per VAL-051 Rule A. Pooled-entropy reported as secondary for transparency.

lessons.context: AIBL holdout n=33 AD + 95 HC, 7-CpG directional panel
lessons.quirk: Directional scoring recovered the signal at d=+0.624 AUC=0.68 on the SAME cohort, SAME CpGs (7 selected from the 18 by |Δβ|>0.015 and q_FDR<0.10 on training split). Same data produced null (pooled) and recovery (directional) — the method mattered, not the data.
lessons.interpretation: Directional-Score Principle: pooled-entropy is correct for uniform-direction drift (breast, CRC) and wrong for bidirectional drift (AD, likely autoimmune). Cards report both scores to guard against this failure mode per README_MASTER.

lessons.quirk: Raw d=+0.33 replicated direction but at lower magnitude than AIBL. Age regression reduced residual d to +0.12 — 63% of the AddNeuroMed raw signal is age-tracked.
lessons.interpretation: AD age-confounding is substantial. Age-regressed A_dir is mandatory primary clinical metric; raw A_dir reported for transparency. Stronger AIBL effect (d=+0.624) may be partly AIBL-specific (cohort imaging-biomarker selection enrichment).
lessons.applied_to_card: Report MUST use age-regressed A_dir as primary clinical metric per §E.5. Raw A_dir secondary.

lessons.context: GSE53740 Ferrari 2014, n=384, GIFT UCSF-MAC, 193 HC + 15 AD + 128 FTD + 44 PSP/CBD
lessons.quirk_1_pooled_null: Pre-registered pooled A_dir produced d=+0.013 p=0.96 NULL on GSE53740 AD.
lessons.quirk_2_sex_recovery: Post-hoc sex stratification recovered male AD d=+0.415 (n=7), quantitatively consistent with AIBL male d=+0.512. Female AD d=-0.131 (n=7) did NOT replicate AIBL female d=+0.705. Pooled null arose from opposing sex contributions averaging to zero, not absence of signal.
lessons.quirk_3_tauopathy_specificity: PSP/CBD preserved 5/7 frozen Rule A directions while AD preserved 4/7 (near chance 3.5/7). PSP/CBD raw d=+0.185 exceeded AD raw d=+0.013. The AIBL-derived panel direction pattern matches tauopathy-associated drift as well as or better than AD-specific drift in GSE53740.
lessons.quirk_4_cohort_batch_offset: GSE53740 HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 SD above the 80-cell Cookbook baseline — systematic cohort-level batch offset from Ferrari 2014 ComBat + quantile normalization. Not biological. Implies the Cookbook 80-cell baseline cannot be directly applied to any non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort without cross-cohort normalization.
lessons.interpretation_combined: GSE53740 pooled null is honest but does not overturn AIBL/AddNeuroMed replication. Sex-stratified male recovery + PSP/CBD tauopathy-directional trend + cohort batch offset all materially qualify the panel interpretation. Tier stays cross_platform_validated but the card adds explicit sex-stratification requirement, tauopathy-specificity caveat, and cross-cohort-normalization requirement.
lessons.applied_to_card: Multiple known_limitations entries, new validation_anchors entry for VAL-057 consolidated, expected_direction caveat for tauopathy discrimination, deployment_rule for sex stratification.

lessons.quirk: Pre-reg sealed 2026-04-24 05:44 UTC locked only the pooled A_dir test with 5-outcome decision matrix. It did NOT pre-register sex stratification despite VAL-051 having reported sex-split results. It did NOT pre-register per-CpG directional check despite the 7-CpG panel having 2:5 direction split. It did NOT pre-register the 80-cell age anchor despite that baseline existing in the Cookbook. All three omissions were added post-hoc after the pooled null.
lessons.interpretation: A more rigorous pre-reg would have locked sex-stratified, per-CpG, and 80-cell-anchored analyses alongside the pooled primary, with their own decision rules. This is a process lesson, not a methodology failure — the post-hoc analyses are valid, but a better pre-reg would have eliminated the post-hoc label entirely.
lessons.applied_to_card: Future pre-registrations (starting with VAL-058 onward if relevant) must include: (a) primary pooled test, (b) sex-stratified test, (c) per-CpG directional preservation check, (d) 80-cell or equivalent anchor check, (e) cohort batch-offset check. Lock all five decision rules before data access.

next_validation_steps: ADNI per-patient replication when dbGaP access opens (highest priority; n~135 AD, EPIC 850K, independent 4th cohort).

Synucleinopathy (PD, DLB) cohort specificity test: apply frozen Rule A panel to test whether the AD-directional signature extends to non-tauopathy neurodegeneration. Candidate: GSE111629 (Horvath PD blood).

FTD-subtype-stratified analysis on GSE53740: separate FTD-tau, FTD-TDP-43, FTD-FUS, FTD-MND where subtype metadata is available. 2/7 FTD directional preservation on aggregate may be diluting distinct per-subtype signatures.
Cross-cohort normalization method for deploying 80-cell baseline outside AIBL/AddNeuroMed preprocessing pipelines. Without this, EDEAR cannot be deployed on arbitrary GEO cohorts.
Pre-registration discipline upgrade: all future panel-generalization tests must lock sex-stratified, per-CpG-directional, 80-cell-anchored, and cohort-offset analyses in the pre-reg, not post-hoc.
